claims.statement: Effective moduli are calculated for specified crack patterns; loading-driven crack evolution is deferred.
The construction uses a two-dimensional cylindrical-grain assembly.
Bond width and crack width are treated as known orientation functions.
The comparison concerns undamaged isotropic moduli against a discrete-element numerical sample, not a laboratory damage-evolution validation.
